description: This header file defines a utility class 'nmUtils' within the WPEFramework::Plugin namespace, providing static methods for network device properties, interface status, security modes, frequency conversions, and persistent configurations related to NetworkManager in a GNOME environment.

classes.name: nmUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for network and device property management in a GNOME environment integrated with NetworkManager.

methods.name: getDeviceProperties
methods.description: Retrieves properties of the network device.

methods.name: deviceHostname
methods.description: Gets the device hostname from persistent storage.

methods.name: convertPercentageToSignalStrength
methods.description: Converts a percentage value to a Wi-Fi signal strength measurement.

methods.name: caseInsensitiveCompare
methods.description: Performs a case-insensitive comparison between two strings.

methods.name: wifiSecurityModeFromAp
methods.description: Determines the Wi-Fi security mode from access point flags.

methods.name: wifiFrequencyFromAp
methods.description: Converts access point frequency to a double value.

methods.name: getSecurityModeString
methods.description: Returns a string describing the security mode based on flags.

methods.name: setNetworkManagerlogLevelToTrace
methods.description: Sets the NetworkManager log level to trace for debugging.

methods.name: setMarkerFile
methods.description: Creates or removes a marker file based on the filename and unmark flag.

methods.name: isInterfaceEnabled
methods.description: Checks if a network interface is enabled.
